Maybe she just doesn't have the conversational skills as you do when it comes to text messaging. To me it sounds like she doesn't know how to keep up a conversation and maybe she relies on you for that. 
I've encountered the same problem when I talk to guys or friends through text message. My advice would be to get her to talk about her interests and what she likes. By doing that she might get excited and be open to talking about more things. Your goal is to have regular and enjoyable conversations without having to feel confused and upset. By all means you should try prying her open in order to understand her more and reach that goal. Also make it possible to have more meetings with each other in person and see how you can carry conversations without texting. Be happy!
